title: Machine learning approach combined with causal relationship inferring unlocks the shared pathomechanism between COVID-19 and acute myocardial infarction
summary: The study reports shared gene/pathway relationships and an Extra Trees AMI prediction with AUC 0.892, compared with a troponin baseline. These are computational associations and prediction results, not proof of a causal shared mechanism or clinical benefit.
ai_technology: LASSO, recursive feature elimination, random forest and Bayesian-network analyses examine gene-expression datasets for shared COVID-19 and acute-myocardial-infarction pathways.
